added_after_the_survey.demodiff: DemoDiffusion (Park et al., arXiv 2506.20668, ICRA 2026): the demo chunk at the episode step, noised to flow time s* = 0.2 (their setting when the prior's success is zero) and denoised by the frozen pi0.5 in 20 steps (their fork); gripper included; our client's replan interval of 5
added_after_the_survey.demodiff_state: the same with the demo chunk chosen by our state alignment (pose key, window 20)
added_after_the_survey.fullft: full fine-tuning of the action expert, 1000 steps, lr 2.5e-5, fp32 master weights
added_after_the_survey.lora_eq: equal-bytes adapter: rank 2 on the last two layers of the action expert (258 KB, the fold's size), trained on every demo frame, always on (TAIL-style at our budget: does the program matter?)
added_after_the_survey.lora_r64: LoRA rank 64 on the action expert, 1000 steps (a stronger LoRA)
